chunks: Al-Sakuni narrated from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, peace be upon him, who said:
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “Any woman who leaves her house without her husband’s permission has no maintenance due to her until she returns.”

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman, specifically a wife in the legal context of the narration
key_terms.نَفَقَةَ: maintenance or financial support owed in marriage

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about a wife leaving the house without her husband's permission?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning marital rights and maintenance within the household. It indicates that if a wife leaves the home without her husband's permission, her entitlement to maintenance is suspended until she returns.
